summary: Backend-only regression testing (iteration 3) of BUB Makekal Hulu palm oil app via public URL. Rewrote /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py as pytest with 19 tests covering auth (no lockout, bcrypt, httpOnly cookie), stock-pool, backdated purchases/trips/expenses, DUAL commodity trip revenue+unloading math, editable unloading rates, edit/delete CRUD, WAC recalc after trip delete, batch sync idempotency and dashboard stats. Result: 17/19 passed (89%). Two real defects found: (1) PUT /api/trips/{trip_id} ignores the path id and inserts a brand-new trip when the body omits local_id; (2) GET /api/dashboard/stats is publicly accessible (no JWT required) despite the spec.

critical.issue: Handler simply calls create_sales_trip(payload) and never uses the {trip_id} path param. If the body omits local_id a NEW trip is created (verified: orphan TRIP-16CB861889 with revenue 1,248,000 inserted while the target trip kept its old price 2500). Also returns 200 for non-existent trip ids instead of 404. Fix: force payload.local_id = trip_id (or lookup-then-404) before recomputing.

Returns 200 with full financial data without any JWT/cookie - no Depends(get_current_user) on line ~842. Spec requires 401 when unauthenticated. Full revenue/COGS/margin/receivables data is publicly exposed.

minor.issue: Always returns 200 'berhasil dihapus' even when deleted_count == 0 (unknown id). Should return 404 so the UI does not show a false success.

All write endpoints are unauthenticated. Anyone can create/edit/delete transactions or wipe all data via POST /api/seed-demo (which delete_many's purchases, trips, expenses). At minimum protect /seed-demo.

farmer_name is interpolated directly into a MongoDB $regex ({'$regex': f'^{name}$'}). Special regex chars in a farmer name (e.g. 'Pak (Budi)') can raise a regex error / cause ReDoS. Escape with re.escape().
Uses PurchaseTransactionCreate so all fields are required-ish; partial updates are not supported and omitted optional fields (photo_url, notes) get reset to defaults.

action_items: PUT /api/trips/{trip_id}: bind payload.local_id to the path trip_id and 404 when the trip does not exist (currently creates duplicate trips).
Add Depends(get_current_user) to GET /api/dashboard/stats (spec: 401 without JWT).
Return 404 from DELETE endpoints when deleted_count == 0.
Protect write endpoints (especially POST /api/seed-demo which deletes all transactional data) with JWT.
re.escape() farmer_name before using it in a Mongo $regex query.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PUT /trips delegates to create_sales_trip without using trip_id -> silent duplicate insert; classic upsert-by-body-id bug.
server.py is 1041 lines; split into routers/ (auth, purchases, trips, expenses, dashboard) + services/stock_pool.py.
compute_virtual_stock_pool() loads up to 10k purchases + 5k trips into memory on every stock-pool/trip/sync/dashboard call - move to aggregation pipeline before data grows.
POST /api/sync swallows per-item exceptions and only logs them; the response counts do not reflect failures, so an offline client will mark failed records as synced. Return a per-item failures array.
seed_data_creation: Created and then cleaned up TEST_-prefixed purchases/trips/expenses (local_ids PUR-TEST*, TRIP-TEST*, EXP-TEST*). Also removed the orphan trip TRIP-16CB861889 produced by the PUT bug. DB left with only the 2 demo trips + demo purchases/expenses.

context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and self-cleans (session fixture 'created'). Verified passing: DUAL trip (commodity_type='DUAL', total_revenue=3,391,000 = 2,430,000 grade_a + 841,000 berondol_sold + 120,000 berondol_grade_b; unloading_cost=56,900 with defaults 40k/60k per ton and 72,600 with custom 50k/80k), backdate on purchases/trips/expenses, PUT purchase recompute (400kg*2500=1,000,000), 404 on PUT unknown purchase, deletes, WAC/grade_b_returned reverting after trip delete, sync idempotency (no duplicates on repeat). Only the 2 tests listed in backend_issues.critical fail - re-run the same file after fixes.
rca_of_the_issue: PUT /api/trips/{trip_id} (server.py ~line 712) is `res = await create_sales_trip(payload)`. create_sales_trip derives local_id from payload.local_id or generates a fresh one, so the path parameter is dead code: with local_id in the body it happens to upsert correctly, without it a new trip document is inserted and the intended record is untouched. GET /api/dashboard/stats (~line 842) has no dependency injection for auth, so the JWT requirement stated in the spec is not enforced.
